title: Signal: CodeIgniter uncaught-exception page disclosed
scope: One response body containing the CodeIgniter exception template with a file location block.
limitations: One response body. The rule recognises the framework template; it does not prove that the path it prints is readable from outside.

observation.body:
An uncaught Exception was encountered

Type: RuntimeException

Message: Order not found

Filename: /var/www/app/controllers/Orders.php

Line Number: 42

An uncaught Exception was encountered

Filename: /srv/site/system/core/Common.php

Line Number: 573

Handling exceptions

An uncaught exception should be logged and rendered as a generic page.

fpNotes: A generic 500 page is not reported. A documentation page that quotes the template is reported when it reproduces the heading and the location block together.
